description: This Python source file defines the 'ClinicalAgent' class responsible for generating medical guideline-based suggestions for clinical scenarios. It performs retrieval from a vector store, heuristic extraction of recommended tests and medicines, and formats outputs including a structured dict and a flattened list, always appending a medical disclaimer.
